from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687644/attempts/d21481a4026048e6979815abbac7f6cc/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]!=bg:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    candidates=[comp for comp in comps if max(c for r,c in comp)<w-1]
    if not candidates: return g
    rightmost=max(max(c for r,c in comp) for comp in candidates)
    comp=max((x for x in candidates if max(c for r,c in x)==rightmost), key=len)
    rows={r for r,c in comp if c==rightmost}
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(rightmost+1,w): g[r][c]=1
    return g
'''
